This can help them communicate their feelings and concerns without feeling overwhelmed or defensive. 3. **Focus on the community gathering**: Emphasize the importance of the community gathering and how their presence would benefit everyone. Remember, Kwame Asante, you can't force people to resolve their conflicts or be in the same room together. Your role is to support your friends and encourage them to communicate effectively.
